The '''WESTAR-20''' was a short [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and the predecessor to the [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|WESTAR-34 blaster pistol]]. [[Omega Squad]]'s [[Fi Skirata]] carried a custom WESTAR-20 during his stay on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], after being pronounced brain dead and leaving the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="O66" />
